name: Matheme — QL and Spanda
description: Eight QL mathemes and the Spanda equations: the native relational derivation, its count, the crossed-zero recognition sequence, and both Spanda equations as step sequences. Source revision dbf3b17; census T25.

text.title: 0/1 ↔ 1/0 — The Native Relational Derivation
text.italic: The same relation read from its two ends; the defined/undefined seam stays active.
text.body: 0/1 reads the ground through its expression; 1/0 the expression towards its ground — QL writes 0/1 = 1/0 as a relational identity. Arithmetic keeps the seam: 0/1 = 0, 1/0 undefined. The outer slash holds the pair: (0/1)/(1/0). Four ordered pairings plus the retained terms give 2+2² = 4+2; the returning parent (1/0)/(0/1) carries the whole in inverse phase.

text.title: The Two Ones — Numerical Firstness and Relational Office
text.italic: 0 = One, 1 = All; the counted one can hold what its counting distinguishes.
text.body: The native assignment: 0 = One, 1 = All. Von Neumann floors it: 0 = ∅, 1 = {∅}, 2 = {0,1}, successor S(n) = n ∪ {n}. The singleton is not empty — its element is the empty set; the counted one holds what its counting distinguishes (Argued, not a change to cardinality). Enumeration from zero and counting from one keep different firstness conventions.

text.title: The Slash — Selection and Co-presence
text.italic: Selected difference with the field of co-presence retained.
text.body: / carries two native operations: OR makes a determinate selection; AND retains the field in which the alternatives belong. Naming the selected value does not record the field, criterion or exclusions. Applied twice to the relation: 0/1, then (0/1)/(1/0) — the outer slash acting on two complete first-order relations. Division bar, quotient and Sheffer stroke share graphics without sharing the operation.

text.title: Six Positions, Eight Turns
text.italic: Centre the 0/1 threshold; four stations N/E/W/S; the ring the #0/#5 envelope — frame, never content.
text.body: Qualitative body: #0 0/1, #1 ?/!, #2 −/+, #3 X/x, #4 AM/IS, #5 ∞/dx. Slash-form: (0/1)/(1/0), 0/0 = %, 0/1, 1/0 = ?/!, 1/1 = 100%, (1/0)/(0/1). Qualitative ?/! at #1 and processual ?/! at #3 keep different offices. Parent −/− and return 1/0 bracket the six: eight turns. Stations at the degree-table compass points; the ring the #0/#5 envelope — the mandala as the torus flat projection, 4+2.

text.title: 2 + 2² — Binary and Binary-of-Binary
text.italic: The two includes its act of distinction: terms and ordered relations counted without conflating types.
text.body: B×B = {(0,0),(0,1),(1,0),(1,1)}: |B×B| = 4, order matters — the off-diagonal pairs keep opposed orientations. A tagged disjoint union counts terms and relations without conflating types: 2+4 = 6, the native 2+2² = 4+2. The count establishes cardinality and ordered structure; the qualitative sequence needs its own derivation. 2⁶+6²=100 is a later accountative construction, not a renaming of these six.

text.title: Crossed Zero and Native Re-entry
text.italic: 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↷ 0/1 — occlusion, mediation, field-availability, recognition.
text.body: The recognition sequence 0 → Ø → X → Ø/X → (0/Ø)/(1/X) → 1 ↷ 0/1. At Ø the slash fuses: "I am this description." At X the discrimination articulates a world. Ø/X recognises the medium as medium — no second observer behind the first. (0/Ø)/(1/X) holds subject-side and object-side recognition in one field; cancelling identical-looking symbols would erase the relations. 1 affirms the linking one; return is 0/1.

text.title: X/x: Specification without Exhaustion
text.italic: An actual value can be genuine without being the last value the variable can bear.
text.body: X capacity, x particular — indefinite before specification, definite in assignment. x+2=5 gives x=3 exactly; x+2=7 gives 5: no solution consumes the capacity. X/x cannot be cancelled like a quotient of scalars. The psychic unit X=x reads identity-through-difference; the agentic crosswalk is Argued — record the result with the conditions that constrained it, then let a changed context produce another result. Phenomenal subjectivity stays Open.

text.title: Complex Orientation: Measure through Rotation
text.italic: State the object, the transformation, the retained relation: point, rotation, modulus 5.
text.body: For 4+3i the coordinates are perpendicular: |z|² = 16+9 = 25, |z| = 5 — the explicate 2⁴ and implicate 3² as squared contributions of lengths 4 and 3. Quarter-turns by i preserve the modulus at every step; |e^{iφ}z|² = |z|² is a property of this transformation — scaling by 2 would double it. State the object, the transformation, the retained relation: point, rotation, modulus 5.

text.title: Spanda Equations and Inversion / Return
text.italic: One sixfold through two readings; the remainder completes the return.
text.body: First: 0=(0/0) → (0/1)/(1/0) → [T₀] → [T₁] → (1/0+0/1) → 1/1 = 100%; the bridge is native gathering, not a real-fraction sum. Second: 100% ⇝ 2⁶+6² = 64+36 → 64/36 → ÷4 → 16/9 = 2⁴/3² = (4/3)² → 4+2 / 4:2. Cross-comparison (4:2)/(3:3) gives (4/3, 2/3). The remainder completes the return: 2/(16/9) = 9/8; (16/9)(9/8) = 2. The comma 531441/524288 stays exact.
